IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_NotOnYou: Only items you carry can go on the hotbar
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_NoRoom: No room in %1: kept in your inventory
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_ActionToolti: What clicking the slot or pressing its key does. The usual action takes the item out of its bag and puts it back afterwards; or pick any action from the item's own menu.
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_DefaultEquip: Take out and equip, or put back (usual)
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_DefaultWear: Wear, or take off and put back (usual)
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_CarryToPick: Carry a %1 to choose its action
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_DragHint: Or drag an item from your inventory onto the bar
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_AddLabel: Add an item: click, or drag one here
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_GameReset: Put the game's hotbar back at the bottom
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipLocked: Locked: click to allow moving the bar and its slots
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipUnlocked: Click to lock the bar and its slots in place
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipGameLocke: Locked: click to allow moving the game's hotbar and its slots
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipGameUnloc: Click to lock the game's hotbar and its slots in place
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipSwap: Dropping a slot swaps it with the slot under it (click: insert instead)
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipInsert: Dropping a slot moves it there and shifts the others (click: swap instead)
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_TipHide: Hide this hotbar (the eye on the game's hotbar shows it again)
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_StepsTooltip: More items this slot uses, one after the other, after its own item. A step with the usual action follows the slot's item: when the slot takes its item out, the step takes its item out too, and when the slot puts its item back, so does the step. A step with an action from its item's menu always does that action.
IGUI_TienCustomizableHotbar_StepFollowTo: On: taken out when the slot's item is taken out, put back when it is put back. Off: taken out or put back on its own, like a slot of its own. Only for the usual action.
